children.name: The University is committed to fostering a vibrant and intellectually stimulating campus environment. The FEvents platform serves as the central administrative nexus for coordinating extracurricular, academic, and social gatherings. This document establishes the foundational principles and operational mandates required to ensure that all events align with the institution's core values, prioritize participant safety, and optimize the utilization of shared resources.
children.characters:
The University is committed to fostering a vibrant and intellectually stimulating campus environment. The
FEvents platform serves as the central administrative nexus for coordinating extracurricular, academic, and
social gatherings. This document establishes the foundational principles and operational mandates required to
ensure that all events align with the institution's core values, prioritize participant safety, and optimize the
utilization of shared resources.

children.name: By utilizing the FEvents system to reserve venues or advertise activities, all student organizations, faculty members, and external partners explicitly agree to adhere to the stipulations detailed within this Campus Policy. Failure to comply may result in the revocation of hosting privileges or further disciplinary action as outlined in Section 5.
children.characters:
By utilizing the FEvents system to reserve venues or advertise activities, all student organizations, faculty
members, and external partners explicitly agree to adhere to the stipulations detailed within this Campus Policy.
Failure to comply may result in the revocation of hosting privileges or further disciplinary action as outlined in
Section 5.

children.name: All activities hosted on university premises must be conducted in a manner that respects the rights, safety, and dignity of all community members. Events must not disrupt the primary academic functions of the university, including scheduled classes, research activities, or administrative operations.
children.characters:
All activities hosted on university premises must be conducted in a manner that respects the rights, safety, and
dignity of all community members. Events must not disrupt the primary academic functions of the university,
including scheduled classes, research activities, or administrative operations.

children.name: Strong → Inclusivity:
children.characters:
Inclusivity: Events must remain accessible to all authorized attendees regardless of race, gender, religion, or
orientation, in accordance with the University Non-Discrimination Charter.

children.name: Strong → Noise Limitations:
children.characters:
Noise Limitations: Amplified sound must adhere to zoning regulations. Events near residential halls or active
academic buildings must conclude high-decibel activities by 10:00 PM local time.

children.name: Strong → Property Respect:
children.characters:
Property Respect: Organizers are strictly liable for any damage to university venues. Pre-event and post-
event condition reports must be submitted via the FEvents dashboard.

children.name: The procedural requirements for initiating an event depend on its scale, target audience, and risk profile. All requests must be submitted through the FEvents portal adhering to the stipulated timelines.
children.characters:
The procedural requirements for initiating an event depend on its scale, target audience, and risk profile. All
requests must be submitted through the FEvents portal adhering to the stipulated timelines.

children.name: Under 50 attendees, no external speakers, no catering. Requires 48-hour notice. Auto-approved pending venue availability.
children.characters:
Under 50 attendees, no external speakers, no catering. Requires 48-hour notice. Auto-approved pending venue
availability.

children.name: 50-200 attendees, internal catering, simple AV needs. Requires 2 weeks notice. Subject to administrative review.
children.characters: 50-200 attendees, internal catering, simple AV needs. Requires 2 weeks notice. Subject to administrative review.

children.name: 200+ attendees, external speakers, alcohol service, or high-profile nature. Requires 6 weeks notice and a dedicated risk assessment meeting.
children.characters:
200+ attendees, external speakers, alcohol service, or high-profile nature. Requires 6 weeks notice and a dedicated risk
assessment meeting.

children.name: Organizations found circumventing the tier system by misrepresenting attendance or event scope will face immediate suspension of their FEvents account.
children.characters:
Organizations found circumventing the tier system by misrepresenting attendance or event scope will face
immediate suspension of their FEvents account.

children.name: The preservation of a secure environment is paramount. Campus Security reserves the right to terminate any event that poses an immediate threat to public safety or severely violates institutional protocols.
children.characters:
The preservation of a secure environment is paramount. Campus Security reserves the right to terminate any
event that poses an immediate threat to public safety or severely violates institutional protocols.

children.name: For Tier 3 events, or events identified as high-risk during the review process, organizers must cover the cost of designated Campus Security personnel. The ratio of security officers to attendees will be determined exclusively by the Department of Campus Safety based on the submitted event itinerary.
children.characters:
For Tier 3 events, or events identified as high-risk during the review process, organizers must cover the cost of
designated Campus Security personnel. The ratio of security officers to attendees will be determined
exclusively by the Department of Campus Safety based on the submitted event itinerary.

children.name: Emergency egress routes must remain unobstructed at all times. Alteration of venue capacities or removal of standard fire safety equipment is strictly prohibited and constitutes a federal violation.
children.characters:
Emergency egress routes must remain unobstructed at all times. Alteration of venue capacities or removal of
standard fire safety equipment is strictly prohibited and constitutes a federal violation.

children.name: The University Management team monitors compliance across all FEvents activities. Violations of this policy are categorized by severity, resulting in a progressive disciplinary framework.
children.characters:
The University Management team monitors compliance across all FEvents activities. Violations of this policy are
categorized by severity, resulting in a progressive disciplinary framework.

children.name: Strong → Minor Infractions:
children.characters:
Minor Infractions: e.g., failure to clean venue, minor noise complaints. Results in a formal warning and
potential fine deducted from the organization's deposit.

children.name: Strong → Major Infractions:
children.characters:
Major Infractions: e.g., capacity violations, unauthorized alcohol, unapproved external speakers. Results in
immediate event shutdown, up to a 6-month suspension from FEvents, and referral to the Dean of
Students.

children.name: Strong → Critical Violations:
children.characters:
Critical Violations: e.g., severe safety hazards, property destruction, legal offenses. Results in permanent
revocation of hosting privileges and potential legal prosecution.
